name: rankrat
description: Self-hosted SEO intelligence over Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Bing Webmaster Tools, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, PageSpeed, CrUX, Cloudflare, IndexNow, and optional local Lighthouse — persistent monitoring, internal-link and content opportunities, ownership, remediation, onboarding, managed edge redirects, safe Bing content submission, and Bing backlink intelligence. Writable by default with one read-only switch. MCP over stdio and Streamable HTTP, plus REST.

interface.longDescription: Audit, onboard, and monitor owned sites, inspect search and analytics evidence, and apply provider-account-authorized SEO remediation through Rankrat's MCP and REST transports.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Rankrat to inspect the configured provider accounts and sites, explain current SEO evidence, and carry out the requested supported actions.
